findings.title: F1 tint makes filled danger-button labels unreadable on the six light suite palettes (KyPulse, KyDrive)
repositories: ky-server-base (rule and .btn-danger defined; no .btn-danger element in source)
locations: kyPulse-server web/src/styles/theme.css:104-109 (F1 :not() rule) with :203-206 (.btn-danger background var(--danger), color var(--button-text, #fff))
Used by: KyPulse KyYardCard.tsx:76 Unpair, WebhookForm.tsx:119 Remove webhook, AppDetail.tsx:118 Delete; KyDrive Dialog.tsx:43 (danger confirm), Devices.tsx:63 Revoke computer
findings.what: The F1 rule mixes --danger 50% toward the palette --ink-strong. On light palettes that makes --danger dark, and the filled .btn-danger keeps the palette --button-text, which is also dark. Status text now passes, but the destructive-action button label sits dark-on-dark-red.

evidence.harness: v2-review-work/harness/danger-button.mjs and danger-button-dist.mjs (real element, computed colour vs computed background, canvas colour conversion, transitions disabled)
evidence.screenshot: v2-review-work/evidence/f7-pulse-dist-danger-button-preF1-vs-head.png (synthetic strip, shipped Pulse CSS; pre-F1 row above head row for sky, polished-ky, sun)
evidence.why_tests_missed: web/browser/ui.spec.mjs F1 assertions measure only --danger/--success text against --bg/--panel, not button label on danger fill.

findings.note: Pre-F1 values were already below 4.5 for five light palettes (rollout gap); the F1 fix made them roughly 3x worse.
findings.verification: Re-run danger-button.mjs and danger-button-dist.mjs (rebuilt Pulse dist): every suite palette >= 4.5. Add a ui.spec assertion on a rendered .btn-danger.
